Speed-separation finding: quantitative EPS surprise peak at announcement is largely eliminated by next market open; qualitative ECT (earnings call transcript) sentiment peaks on NEXT trading day — real and tradeable but hidden under prior volatility-optimizing evaluation. patch.content: h376_status: PROPOSED (2026-07-06) — EarningsInOne Fast/Slow Dual-Signal PEAD. Source: Yu, Liu, Zhang, He (2026) "Fast Numbers, Slow Language: Bridging Quantitative and Qualitative Earnings Signals" arXiv:2606.29734. Key finding: EarningsInOne corpus (SP 1500, 2022-2025) demonstrates a clean speed separation — quantitative EPS/revenue surprise peaks within minutes of announcement and is largely eliminated by the next market open; qualitative ECT (earnings call transcript) sentiment peaks on the NEXT trading day, real and tradeable but previously hidden because prior transcript evaluations optimised sign-agnostic volatility (MSE) rather than directional return. This directly addresses H317's failure (arXiv:2509.24254 approach): H317 tried to combine EPS + pre-momentum filters but reduced n below 20; H376 instead separates signals by SPEED — H174 fast EPS signal at open (unchanged) + new slow ECT confirmation signal for a second-day continuation trade. Implementation: (1) H174 OPG entry as before; (2) At 4 PM same day, score earnings call transcript via FinBERT/GPT-4o-mini; (3) If ECT score >= 0.15 AND position is profitable, hold 2 additional trading days beyond normal 20-day exit schedule; (4) If ECT score is NEGATIVE (< -0.05), exit position at 4 PM rather than waiting 20 days. Universe: H174 confirmed events (score >= 0.18 AND surprise >= 0.02). Gate: OOS WR > 0.818 (H174 baseline), mean_ret > 6.89%, n >= 15. IS: 2019-2022, OOS: 2023-present. FMP transcript API caveat (H247: 403 on free plan); EDGAR MD&A or Alpaca news as fallback. $OPENAI_API_KEY available. Note: EarningsInOne data covers SP 1500 (broader than H174's H198 universe subset); replication on H174 confirmed event list is the target. Script: backtesting/daily/run_h376.py (to be written).
